thread:
maria: Heads-up — saw burst yday where time-sliced nodepool (1/4 slices) scaled from 2 -> 12 and our app p99 jumped ~450ms. Cost for the spike looked ~1.8x for that window. Anyone else seeing weird cold-starts with slice-based pools?
kevin: Yep, saw the same. Problem seemed to be kube-provisioner not prewarming MIG-backed nodes; new pods waited for slice init + docker image pull.
ev an: (small note) time-sliced VMs take extra host-level setup that's not instant. MIG + timeslice = more scheduling variance than full-GPU nodes.
sophie: Summary of what I think happened: cluster-autoscaler spun up fractional GPUs in the slice pool -> AWS (region eu-west-1) placed instances in AZ-b -> ENI limits delayed kubelet registration -> taints prevented fallback -> our fallback pool was empty -> p99 spike.
maria: Exact. We only have 2 nodes in the fallback pool (full GPUs) and CA can't mix instance types because of our nodeSelector constraints.
kevin: Quick proposals: 1) add a small prewarm buffer (min=3) for slice pool; 2) relax nodeSelector so CA can pack into fallback when slice provisioning is slow; 3) tuning scaleDown/scaleUp delay for CA.
evan: +1 for prewarm buffer. Also consider changing expander policy to least-waste and enable --balance-similar-node-groups. reduces cross-pool oscillation.
sophie: Wanted to capture a config snippet I tested locally:
```yaml
# cluster-autoscaler args
--expander=least-waste
--scale-down-delay-after-add=10m
--max-empty-bulk-delete=2
--balance-similar-node-groups=true
```
kevin: We should also tweak node-template for slice pool: smaller image size, lighter init containers, and enable image pre-pull via DaemonSet on on-demand prewarm nodes.
maria: Ops concern: prewarm nodes cost baseline $0.85/hr for the instance type we use. If we keep 3 prewarm nodes 24/7 that's ~ $61/day across region — too high unless we can autoscale them down during low hours.
evan: Simple back-of-envelope: 3 * 0.85 * 24 = 61.2 USD/day. If spikes happen only 4h/day, we can run prewarm with schedule and auto-scale by time-of-day.
sophie: Also, check AWS quota for ENIs: when lots of fractional nodes spin up we hit vpc-ip-per-interface and get rate-limited. CA logs show FAILED_ATTEMPT with ENI errors.
maria: Ops-bot, can you paste the autoscaler event from the spike window?
ops-bot: autoscaler: scaled up nodegroup gpu-slice-eu-2 from 2 to 12 (reason: pods waiting: 48; timestamp: 1978887670)
kevin: That aligns. We also saw repeated docker pulls for the same image because pre-pull not enabled on the new slices. Suggest DaemonSet with imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent & `kubectl cordon` older nodes during rollout.
evan: Another path: use mixed pools where slice nodes have a small on-demand reserve size and we allow fallback to full-GPU pool if slice nodegroup is still provisioning after 60s. Implement via webhook that watches PodNodeSelector and loosens it after a timeout.
sophie: I'm worried about affinity changes and data-locality for KV workloads. For pure inference stateless pods it's ok. We should gate by label: `resourceClass: inference-stateless`.
maria: Action items (short):
- kevin: prototype prewarm DaemonSet + image pre-pull for slice pool (ETA: 2 days)
- evan: test CA expander + balance flags in staging and simulate ENI exhaustion (ETA: 3 days)
- sophie: write failure-mode runbook (what to do when slice provisioning stalls) (ETA: 1 day)
- infra: evaluate scheduled prewarm windows & cost (maria) (ETA: 2 days)

kevin: I'll also throw together a quick cost spreadsheet showing marginal cost vs p99 improvement. sample row: `slice-prewarm-3nodes => +$61/day => p99 improvement ~200ms`.
evan: Note: we should monitor kubelet registration time distribution; add metric `kube_node_registration_latency` to node exporter.
maria: Fine plan. If staging results look good we'll promote and add guardrails to rollback if cost > threshold.
sophie: tagging note: please include `pool: slice-prewarm` on prewarm nodes for billing.
kevin: I'll post the PR with the DaemonSet and CA arg changes once validated.
maria: thanks all. I'll update incident board if we see recurrence tonight. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: NOTE: /reminder set to review prewarm metrics in 72h
kevin: cool. closing loop after some runs. :rocket:
